units.id: mission:Exotic Life: New Greenland|	A grizzled man emerges from the fog with an easy, unhurried gait, a laser rifle slung over one shoulder. units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|You steady yourself on the floating city-ship as the necklace of barges, docks, and gantries creak and sway under the influence of Mainsail's endless ocean waves. units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Mainsail|	"Ah, that, my friend, is a Mainsail Seadog, the premier water-sporting hound of the Paradise Planets. Bred some four centuries ago in the ateliers of this very planet, they marry old water-dog stock with dolphin and otter blood, with a touch of beaver for the tail, crocodile for the jaws, and barracuda for the strike," he says with a wink. "They'll nose out a school, haul in the finest fish, and lay a damp, grateful head upon your boots - a prized rarity since the Republic put a lid on the gene labs."|962|0
